scripts.schema: node -e "import('pg').then(async({default:p})=>{const fs=await import('node:fs');const d=await import('dotenv');d.config();const c=new p.Client({host:process.env.DB_HOST,port:process.env.DB_PORT,database:process.env.DB_NAME,user:process.env.DB_USER,password:process.env.DB_PASSWORD});await c.connect();await c.query(fs.readFileSync('10_schema.sql','utf8'));await c.end();console.log('schema applied');})"
